channel.title: mantbyte
channel.description: Personal blog of a Computer Science student covering technology, geopolitics, and what I'm learning.

item.title: The GrapheneOS Duress Password Prosecution: Border Security, Anti-Forensics, and the Law
item.description: Discover how the arrest of Sam Tunick at the US border over a GrapheneOS duress wipe sets a dangerous legal precedent for digital privacy and anti-forensics.

item.title: The DeepSeek Breakthrough: How Algorithmic Efficiency is Closing the US-China AI Compute Gap
item.description: DeepSeek's low-cost training of frontier models proves that smarter code can overcome hardware scarcity. Explore how algorithmic efficiency is redefining the global AI arms race.

item.title: The DeepSeek Strategy: Engineering High-Performance AI Under Compute Constraints
item.description: As US export controls limit access to high-end GPUs, DeepSeek is rewriting the AI playbook by prioritizing architectural efficiency over raw compute power.

item.title: Beating the Compute Ban: How DeepSeek's Architecture Solves Hardware Bottlenecks
item.description: Faced with severe hardware sanctions, DeepSeek pivoted from brute-force scaling to architectural frugality. Explore how DeepSeek-V3 achieved frontier performance for a fraction of the cost.

item.title: Deconstructing SourTrade: Client-Side Malware Assembly via the Bun Runtime
item.description: The SourTrade campaign bypasses traditional signature detection by using browser workers and the Bun runtime to assemble malware locally on the victim's device.

item.title: Anatomy of SourTrade: How Modern Malvertising Uses the Bun Runtime to Assemble Malware Client-Side
item.description: SourTrade represents a dangerous evolution in web-based malware, utilizing browser workers and the Bun runtime to forge malware completely client-side.

item.title: The Kubernetes Moment for Open-Weight AI: Standardizing the Infrastructure Stack
item.description: The AI industry is reaching a turning point as open-weight models demand standardized infrastructure to match the cloud-native revolution.

item.title: The 3.1 Gigawatt Ghost: Why AI Data Centers are the New Threat to Grid Stability
item.description: As AI demand surges, the '3.1 Gigawatt Ghost' reveals how instantaneous load drops from data centers are pushing our aging electrical grids to the brink.

item.title: The 3.5 GW Shockwave: Why AI Data Centers Must Evolve to Save the Power Grid
item.description: A massive 3.5 GW load drop in Northern Virginia exposed a critical flaw in our power infrastructure. Learn why AI data centers must evolve to save the grid.

item.title: From Agentic Loops to Context Engineering: Rethinking AI-Driven Root Cause Analysis
item.description: As dynamic agentic loops struggle with token bloat and non-deterministic RCA during cloud outages, SRE teams are turning to context engineering for precise, single-shot diagnoses.

item.title: Preparing Enterprise APIs for Post-Quantum Cryptography: A Developer's Migration Roadmap
item.description: As quantum computing threatens traditional asymmetric encryption, enterprise backend systems face immediate risk from Harvest Now, Decrypt Later attacks. Discover how to migrate your API architecture to post-quantum standards.

item.title: The AI Deflationary Spiral: How AI Coding Tools are Disrupting the Macroeconomics of Global IT Outsourcing
item.description: Generative AI coding tools are breaking the traditional labor-hour model, triggering a deflationary spiral that threatens the global IT outsourcing industry.

item.title: Unsafe Signatures and Secret Spills: Fixing JWT Vulnerabilities in Node.js Open Source Boilerplates
item.description: A recent audit of popular open-source Node.js starter boilerplates revealed critical JWT implementation flaws in every single repository.

item.title: When Open Skies Go Dark: The EU, Copernicus, and the Censorship of Conflict
item.description: When the EU considers restricting open-access Copernicus satellite imagery, the fragile intersection of public data and military security is exposed.

item.title: Code as Free Speech: India's Bitchat Crackdown and the Future of P2P Regulation
item.description: India's unprecedented crackdown on Bitchat's GitHub repositories marks a dangerous shift in internet governance, transforming foundational source code into a state target.

item.title: The Duress Password Dilemma: Technical Privacy vs. Legal Compliance
item.description: A recent federal indictment over a duress password wipe has sparked a critical debate between privacy-by-design engineering and federal obstruction laws.

item.title: AI-Generated CORS Misconfigurations and Origin Reflection Vulnerabilities
item.description: AI coding assistants solve frontend blockers quickly, but they often generate dangerous CORS misconfigurations that lead to severe security vulnerabilities.

item.title: The Architecture of Safety: A Deep Dive into the Anthropic Claude Model Series
item.description: Discover how Anthropic’s Claude series uses Constitutional AI and RLAIF to prioritize safety and alignment over raw compute in the race for AGI.

item.title: Building Mantbytes: A Modern, Free, Serverless Blog Architecture
item.description: How I built a high-performance, fully-featured tech blog with authentication, databases, and ad management using 100% free cloud infrastructure.

item.title: The Silicon Cold War: How Semiconductors Became the New Oil
item.description: As artificial intelligence accelerates, the global supply chain for advanced microchips has become the ultimate geopolitical chess piece of the 21st century.
